title: Subcontract an operation without material flow
route: Manufacturing ➔ Job Shop ➔ Production Subcontracting ➔ Generate Subcontracting Purchase Documents

tokens.v: One operation of a production order is done by a subcontractor, paid for by a purchase order for a service, while the material goes to the subcontractor's work center as an ordinary issue.

achieves.text: One operation of a production order is done by a subcontractor, paid for by a purchase order for a service, while the material goes to the subcontractor's work center as an ordinary issue.

tokens.v: On the item's routing, Subcontracting with Material Flow is cleared, and the subcontracted operation is ticked Subcontracting, with the subcontractor's work center and a reference operation linked to the subcontractor. On the bill of material, the material is linked to that operation. A purchase order type for subcontracting, such as
SUB

before.text: On the item's routing, Subcontracting with Material Flow is cleared, and the subcontracted operation is ticked Subcontracting, with the subcontractor's work center and a reference operation linked to the subcontractor. On the bill of material, the material is linked to that operation. A purchase order type for subcontracting, such as SUB.

tokens.v: Without material flow the subcontractor is a work center of your own, and its operation is bought as a cost item. The material for that operation is issued to the work center as usual. The purchase order is for the service only; its receipt reports the operation's quantity as done by the subcontractor, and its invoice must be processed before the production order can close.

why.text: Without material flow the subcontractor is a work center of your own, and its operation is bought as a cost item. The material for that operation is issued to the work center as usual.
